comment: Independent C-first dwarvish Valkyrie with symset:Enhanced1 (Handling: UTF8) and msg_window:reverse. ';' farlooks the room floor north of the hero, whose glyph is U+00B7 (C2 B7), so the message and its history entry begin with those two bytes. Ctrl-P lists the history newest first (topl.c tty_doprev_message()'s reversed arm) in a text window, where process_text_window()'s g_putch() of the first byte leaves 'B' (0xC2 with the high bit stripped, recorder patch 006) in column 1 and the ignored 0xB7 does not overwrite it. Varies the full-window recipe by window order, role, and a two-byte rather than three-byte glyph.
